source_message.text:
Hi Tiffany,

Attached is the first draft of the proposal, and here's the Canva link - <https://canva.link/pj6c20va7w0ezec>

A few notes as you review:

\- **General design:** Since the document ended up being nearly twice the original length and we were working on a tight timeline, I focused on creating a consistent design system rather than introducing a lot of unique layouts. That should also make any revisions easier to manage.

\- **Graphics & photos:** I used organic-shaped image frames and a few subtle graphic elements that felt like a good fit for the overall theme without competing with the content.

\- **Section 6: Prioritization:** This section wasn't included in the updated tables document, so I wasn't sure if it should still be part of the proposal.

\- **In-text bolding:** I got a little confused about what was intended to be bolded. The Google Doc had some text highlighted and some in red, and once I got into the layout I wasn't sure which formatting was intentional versus editorial markup.

**\- Links:** I tested all of the hyperlinks and they appear to be working, but it would be great if a second reviewer could click through them as well.

\- **Final review:** This was a pretty tight turnaround, so I'll also be doing another pass tomorrow with fresh eyes to catch anything I may have missed, but I wanted to get this to you today.

Looking forward to hearing your thoughts. Hopefully we're in a good place, and I can fine-tune anything you'd like to adjust after your review.
